# TryIt.jl

> A Julia CLI for creating, browsing, and promoting ephemeral workspaces.

TryIt uses one high-level ManyUI selector application and projects it to a
local TUI, native web controls, or a browser-hosted terminal. A legacy
Tachikoma selector remains available while the migration is completed.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](docs/src/getting-started.md): installation, shell setup,
  commands, and configuration.
- [Selector interface](docs/src/interface.md): keyboard interactions, themes,
  backgrounds, and maintenance actions.
- [ManyUI frontends](docs/src/frontends.md): TUI, WebNative, WebTUI, embedding,
  and the backend-neutral background contract.
- [Reference](docs/src/reference.md): Julia API reference.
- [Development](docs/src/development.md): tests, documentation, and releases.

## Key entry points

- `TryIt.main(args)`: process-level CLI entry point.
- `TryIt.launch_selector(; frontend, port, root)`: launch the shared selector
  with `:tui`, `:webnative`, `:webtui`, or `:tachikoma`.
- `TRY_FRONTEND`: select the runtime projection.
- `TRY_BACKGROUND`: select a portable background effect.
